candidateOccurrences.sourceText: From Tappuah the border went along westward to the brook of Kanah; and ended at the sea. This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Ephraim according to their families;
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: It went down from Janoah to Ataroth, to Naarah, reached to Jericho, and went out at the Jordan.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: together with the cities which were set apart for the children of Ephraim in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に場所名が明記される。

candidateOccurrences.sourceText: The land of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh; but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: The border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which is before Shechem. The border went along to the right hand, to the inhabitants of En Tappuah.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: The border went down to the brook of Kanah, southward of the brook. These cities belonged to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh. The border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook, and ended at the sea.
candidateOccurrences.relationshipNoteJa: 固定WEB本文に場所名が明記される。
